fomod.Name: Zenderal - Apocalypse
fomod.Author: Enai Siaion (records) / Zenderal (Enderal patch)
fomod.Description:
Enderal: Forgotten Stories SE patch for Apocalypse - Magic of Skyrim by Enai Siaion.
Apocalypse does nothing in Enderal on its own. Its spell tomes, scrolls and staves are distributed by copying into 54 vanilla Skyrim vendor and loot leveled lists, and not one of those lists exists in Enderal - so no vendor stocks a tome and no chest drops one. Its staff recipes are built at the Dragonborn staff enchanter out of heart stones, neither of which exists here either.
This patch distributes the tomes and scrolls through Enderal's own spell-book vendor and loot lists, retires the unbuildable staff recipes, clears the Dragonborn references from the records that carry them, removes the Daedra and Dwemer summons as un-Enderal, and renames the spells named after Elder Scrolls gods and mages.
REQUIRES Apocalypse - Magic of Skyrim 10.2.3 installed, and Enderal's stub Dragonborn.esm enabled in the profile so Apocalypse's own master requirement is satisfied.
